{{Quote|This is a democracy, and unlike the Republic, corporations do not rule us.|Kerch Kushi speaking against the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance's]] stand on a peace treaty|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
'''Kerch Kushi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]]. Kushi supported the democracy and was opposed to Senator [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell's]] opinions, stating that the corporations did not rule them. He voted in favor of opening [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace negotiations]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kushi was voiced by [[Gideon Emery]], who also voices fellow Separatist [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]]. Kushi's surname was misspelled twice as "Kusi" in the episode guide for "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]."<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> His character model (face) is very similar to the [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|Death Watch bomber]] in the episode "[[The Mandalore Plot]]."
